tolerance.notes: mstl: stl.rs/supsmu.rs are 1:1 ports of R's own stats::stl/stats::supsmu C/Fortran sources, so only floating-point summation order differs (component_abs 1e-8, matching r_stl_strength). classical: the centred moving-average filter and per-phase mean are simple sum/divide chains with no iterative fit, so classical_abs is tighter (1e-10).
